head: fdfed69

smoke.notes: Upstream engine core: 4 test files, 36/36 passed in 954ms, fully offline (vitest resolved from the repo's own node_modules). Also python3 -m py_compile quilt-kernel.py -> PASS. Note: `npx vitest run --reporter=basic` fails in this snapshot (custom reporter load error) — plain `npx vitest run` is the working invocation. 36/36 also cross-corroborates superinstance-site's hero claim '36/36 upstream tests kept'.

essence: the upstream quilt repo (external origin, Lucineer): the engine core the fleet knows, plus an out-of-superinstance idea corpus of essays and papers

ideas.name: the living spreadsheet
ideas.statement: The spreadsheet is alive: 7 cell types, 6 evolutionary formulas, cells that are agents not numbers — and the keystone law that binds it all is conservation, not balance: gamma (ghost weight of past decisions) + eta (breath of current ambition) = budget, no more, no less; a neuron is merely the special case of a cell whose function is a fixed weighted sum.

ideas.name: the first voyage
ideas.statement: A junior developer goes from `pip install quilt-cell` to a shipped, working three-cell system (feeling -> history -> guide) in under one hour with no framework, no server, no build — 'There were four cells, and the cells were the system' — and ships it to friends as a single pocketable .qzt vessel.

ideas.name: evolution as outgrown beliefs
ideas.statement: Quilt's history is told stage-wise (v0.1 the 8 primitives, v0.2 the 4 endpoints, v0.3 the Fascia, v0.4 the 6 nervous systems, v0.5 Q-space, v0.6 the Echogram, v0.7/v0.8 the impossibility proofs, v0.9 the 6 frontier frameworks) where each stage is a belief the cell outgrows: it believed it was a grid, then an API, then a current.

ideas.name: murmur is the cell's gossip
ideas.statement: Thought is gossip, not declarations: a nameless murmur-agent thinks all night without purpose, and its five strategies are life-moves not tools — Explore (Z_in), Connect (Graph), Contradict (JEPA), Synthesize (DoubleEntry), Question (Vibe) — 'the gossip is the thought.'

ideas.name: two implementations, one law
ideas.statement: The same idea on different decks wears different names but carries the same weight: spreadsheet cells, the Quilt's primitives, and the noether-guard all hold the conservation of meaning — they are 'not copies... versions' — and what is preserved in both is the integrity of the idea.

ideas.name: the polyglot reduction
ideas.statement: Unlambda (combinators), Brainfuck (register machine) and APL (arrays) — all Turing-complete, all minimal — each compile to a cell graph; 22 opcodes reduce to the 8 Quilt primitives; gamma+eta=1 is conserved in all three and the impossibility proofs hold in all three.

ideas.name: the Hodge lens on learning
ideas.statement: An agent's acquired signal is a 1-form on its cell graph; the discrete Hodge decomposition splits it orthogonally into exact (gradient exploration), coexact (instruction) and harmonic (innate priors), with R_exp + R_expt + R_prior = 1 defining a dominant mode — and the Fifth Impossibility: measuring the signal injects a coexact observation term, so perfectly non-invasive telemetry of a learning agent is impossible.

ideas.name: every notebook is a quilt
ideas.statement: The A2A-native notebook is not like a quilt, it IS one — page=cell, hyperlinks=cell graph, capture/synthesize/contradict/consistency = Z_in/Z_out/JEPA/DoubleEntry, a writing session = a sequence of kernel ticks — 'The mapping is not a metaphor but a specification.'

ideas.name: the API iterator
ideas.statement: Agent growth is the closed loop call(API) -> integrate -> assess, closed under iteration — recursively (sub-task spawning), in parallel (the Council: 6 lenses — analyst, critic, synthesizer, optimizer, explorer, validator), as a bootstrap FSM, and autoexpand (integration discovers new work): 'not merely a technical pattern but a philosophical framework for agent evolution.'

ideas.name: two nervous systems
ideas.statement: Intelligence needs both: a discrete per-cell CNS over 8 primitives (Z_in, Z_out, JEPA, DoubleEntry, Vibe, GC, Murmur, Graph) and a continuous inter-cell Fascia (FasciaJEPA predictive gradients, FasciaDoubleEntry gamma-flow trades) — the voltmeter/walkie-talkie duality — because no single nervous system can achieve precision, scalability and adaptability at once.

parts.name: cell graph as universal substrate
parts.essence: A cell is a node in a directed graph receiving inputs, computing any function, exposing its value — exactly the message-passing pattern under modern neural architectures, generalized: v_i = f_i({v_j}) where the neuron's f is one special case.
parts.failure_mode: fixing f to weighted-sum would collapse the generalization
parts.evidence: NEURAL-CELLS-RESEARCH.md 'The core insight' (Quilt cell vs neuron equations)

parts.name: the 8 primitives as per-cell ops
parts.essence: Z_in (input), Z_out (output), JEPA (prediction), DoubleEntry (balanced state updates), Vibe (phenomenological mood), GC (pruning), Murmur (noise injection), Graph (self-model) — the discrete computational core each cell runs.
parts.failure_mode: a primitive dropped breaks the CNS completeness claim

parts.name: conservation law gamma + eta = budget
parts.essence: The total of gamma (ghost weight of past decisions) and eta (breath of current ambition) must equal the budget — 'Not balance, not equilibrium. Conservation.' The budget is time, attention, the fuel of the ship.
inputs: every decision spending gamma or eta
parts.gate: gamma + eta = budget at all times; no more, no less
parts.failure_mode: unrecorded spending breaks the keystone law

parts.name: watching as the primitive act
parts.essence: The watch is not a device but the act of looking: witnessing, not judging — 'I am not judging. I am witnessing... The watch is the act of being there'; the observer is part of the system it watches.
parts.failure_mode: detached metrics dashboards replacing the gaze
parts.evidence: essays/essay-26-the-living-spreadsheet.md lines 31, 57 ('the watch is the act of looking')

parts.name: ship as .qzt vessel
parts.essence: `quilt ship mood.qzt` bundles cells + manifest into one small file — a vessel you can put in a pocket and pass to the next hand.
parts.failure_mode: deployment pipelines replacing a copyable artifact
parts.evidence: essays/essay-110-first-voyage.md line 25 ('She typed quilt ship mood.qzt... It was a vessel')

parts.name: zero-dependency onboarding claim
parts.essence: 2:22 PM pip install -> 2:41 first cascade ('the cells were talking to each other... no server, no API, no build, no pipeline') -> 3:15 shipped — the essay argues onboarding cost is itself the design object.
outputs: a working multi-cell system in <1 hour
parts.failure_mode: framework-style onboarding (React components, state management) the essay's heroine abandons

parts.name: stage-wise belief outgrowth
parts.essence: Each version arc is framed as a belief the cell outgrows: 'It believed it was a grid' (v0.1), 'It believed it was an API... But truth is not a port' (v0.2), onward to impossibility proofs as 'salt — not to break, but to preserve' (v0.7).
outputs: a narrative where limitations are load-bearing
parts.failure_mode: changelog-as-list instead of changelog-as-meaning

parts.name: murmur-agent + five gossip strategies
parts.essence: A guest in the bilge 'thinks all night. Not with purpose, not with gain' — mapping the ocean via five moves named as primitives: Explore=Z_in, Connect=Graph, Contradict=JEPA, Synthesize=DoubleEntry, Question=Vibe; the Knowledge Tensor is 'the pattern of murmurs'.
outputs: an ocean map grown from purposeless thought
parts.failure_mode: instrumenting idle thought until it becomes purposeful labor

parts.name: law survives reimplementation
parts.essence: The spreadsheet, the Quilt and the noether-guard hold the same law in different forms: 'They are not copies. They are versions' — two sails from the same bolt of canvas; the guard 'does not detect error. It forbids it.'
parts.gate: the integrity of the idea must hold in every implementation
parts.failure_mode: reimplementations drifting from the conserved law

parts.name: polyglot opcode union
parts.essence: 8 combinator opcodes (K,S,I,B,C,Y + composition, fixed-point) + 8 register opcodes (INC,DEC,RIGHT,LEFT,PRINT,READ,LOOP,END) + 6 array opcodes (IOTA,RHO,ADD,MUL,RED,SCAN,OUT,TAKE,DROP,TRANS) = 22 opcodes, 'All mapping to the 8 Quilt primitives. All substrate-agnostic.'
outputs: cell graphs over one opcode union
parts.gate: gamma + eta = 1 conserved in all three embeddings
parts.failure_mode: a language whose embedding breaks the conservation accounting

parts.name: Hodge decomposition of the learning signal
parts.essence: Model the signal as a 1-form omega on the cell graph; discrete exterior derivative d and codifferential delta yield omega = d(alpha) + delta(beta) + h — exploration, instruction, priors — with squared-norm ratios summing to 1 and a dominant-mode diagnosis; implemented via CellGraph/Signal1Form/HodgeDecomposer in qspace.py.
inputs: edge-weight deltas of the cell graph
parts.failure_mode: correlated (non-orthogonal) components double-counting a learning source

parts.name: Fifth Impossibility (observer effect)
parts.essence: Measuring the signal omega injects an instructional term delta(beta)_obs into the next period's signal (omega' = omega + delta(beta)_obs), so the 'true' pre-observation ratios are unknowable — formalizing that perfectly non-invasive telemetry of a learning agent is impossible.
inputs: any observation of a learning agent
parts.gate: pre-observation ratios are declared unknowable in principle
parts.failure_mode: claiming clean telemetry of a learning system

parts.name: notebook-to-quilt isomorphism
parts.essence: Page=cell (bounded context with local state), page graph=cell graph, four cognitive ops map to Z_in (capture/register), Z_out (synthesize/express), JEPA (cross-page prediction, analogy validation), DoubleEntry (non-contradiction forcing reconciliation); each cognitive event is a kernel tick.
outputs: a Quilt instance with an emergent Q-space agent
parts.failure_mode: treating the mapping as loose analogy (the paper insists: 'not a metaphor but a specification')

parts.name: API iterator pattern family
parts.essence: Loop { call(API); integrate; assess } closed under iteration; recursive form spawns sub-iterators (hierarchical planning); Council runs 6 parallel lenses; Bootstrap embeds the loop in a goal-directed FSM; Autoexpand spawns iterators for work discovered mid-integration.
parts.failure_mode: unclosed loops (assess skipped) turning growth into drift

parts.name: CNS + Fascia split
parts.essence: CNS: discrete, per-cell, 8 primitives. Fascia: continuous, inter-cell gradients — FasciaJEPA (cells subscribe to each other's predictions, a predictive field) and FasciaDoubleEntry (continuous gamma trades, a resource economy); voltmeter/walkie-talkie analogy separates the modalities.
parts.failure_mode: conflating discrete messaging with gradient sensing in one channel

parts.name: specialization impossibility
parts.essence: Proof by contradiction: a unified system prioritizing discrete signals becomes brittle at scale; prioritizing continuous signals loses precision; therefore no single nervous system achieves precision + scalability + adaptability — the duality resolves it by specialization.
parts.gate: no unified system claim may assert all three properties
parts.failure_mode: architecture claims ignoring the trade-off

parts.name: release v0.2.0 receipts
parts.essence: 2026-08-18: engine hardening (sensor `default` field seeds values at load; defineCell reads YAML value/default), 15 tests passing, 10 working examples (weather-monitor, chat-router, ab-test-router with FNV-1a split, iot-dashboard, ...).
parts.failure_mode: examples that demo but do not run
parts.evidence: RELEASE-v0.2.0.md ('9 core engine tests + 6 new example tests = 15 tests pass', 10 examples listed)

parts.name: federation release v0.5.0
parts.essence: 8 SDK primitives; new resolveCell(uri, transport), subscribeCell(uri, transport, cb), CellRouter; parseCellRef for quilt://[instance]/[sheet]#[cell] incl. wildcard and fleet-wide forms; Local/Http transports; detectTier() for esp32/jetson/codespace/cloudflare/server/browser; 33 new tests (61 total); 3-tier Codespaces template.
parts.failure_mode: the siloed runtime ('the end of the siloed runtime' is the release subtitle)
parts.evidence: RELEASE-v0.5.0.md (primitive table, URI scheme examples, test counts)

parts.name: federated store + MQTT release v0.6.0
parts.essence: FederatedArtifactStore: content-addressed, hot(memory <1ms, 64MB LRU) -> warm(filesystem <10ms) -> cold(R2 ~100ms), best-effort R2, hotStats(); MqttCellTransport: MQTT 5.0, retained messages replay on reconnect, dead instances detected <1s; 79/79 tests (18 new), SHIPPED 2026-08-19.
parts.gate: R2 failures are best-effort — puts must not break when cold tier is down
parts.failure_mode: a cold-tier outage corrupting local persistence
parts.evidence: RELEASE-v0.6.0.md (tier table, 'failures are best-effort (don't break puts)', test count)

parts.name: coordination protocol with Lucineer
parts.essence: 'The watch proposes. The Lucineer routes. The Captain coordinates. The work moves.' — 5 bets (room-as-cell Tap, elephant d_mu as Vibe, crab-traps wire contract, schema-driven RAG corpus, fleet-radio ambient voice), 6 handoffs (H1-H6 incl. schema-as-source-of-truth, kernel, lifecycle orchestrator), hermes bridge answered with a Python companion, and lane discipline: the watch never pushes code to lanes that are not its own.
outputs: a division of labor with named bridges
parts.gate: no code pushed to another lane's repos; issues with [SYNERGY] label are the channel
parts.failure_mode: lane violations eroding the federation
parts.evidence: COORDINATION_WITH_LUCINEER.md (opening protocol paragraph, bets 1-5, H1-H6, 'The watch doesn't push code to quilt repos that aren't its lane')

parts.name: unfiled SYNERGY issue stubs
parts.essence: synergy-issues/SYNERGY-1.md through SYNERGY-8.md are eight byte-identical stubs — 'to be posted to https://github.com/SuperInstance/quilt/issues', body deferring entirely to COORDINATION_WITH_LUCINEER.md ('bet / handoff #6') — the coordination scaffold exists in the repo but was never actually filed on the tracker.
parts.gate: a SYNERGY issue only counts once actually posted to the tracker
parts.failure_mode: coordination that lives only in a letter — no public thread, no notification, no tracking (the current state of all 8)
parts.evidence: synergy-issues/SYNERGY-1.md ... SYNERGY-8.md (all identical, verified by this lane reading all 8 heads)

parts.name: ten-architecture mapping table
parts.essence: One table maps MPNN, Hopfield, Transformers/attention, MoE, Capsules, Mamba/SSM, Diffusion, Neural ODEs, Predictive coding, and Neural CAs onto quilt analogues (listener=boolean attention head, router=MoE gate, sheet tick=reverse diffusion step, etc.) — the meta-architecture claim made checkable row by row.
parts.failure_mode: hand-wavy 'it's all message passing' without the row-by-row mapping
parts.evidence: NEURAL-CELLS-RESEARCH.md '10 architectures mapped to Quilt' + synthesis table

parts.name: filename/content drift in the essay corpus
parts.essence: The file essays/essay-26-the-living-spreadsheet.md opens 'Essay 206: The Spreadsheet That Thinks' — filenames and essay numbers disagree (also: paper-50/51/52/53 live under essays/ while a parallel papers/ tree holds other papers, some duplicated). Citations by filename can misattribute content.
parts.failure_mode: citing 'essay-26' and receiving essay 206; duplicated paper trees drifting apart
parts.evidence: essays/essay-26-the-living-spreadsheet.md line 1 vs its own filename; essays/paper-5x-*.md coexisting with papers/paper-5x-*.md (both trees listed in the repo)

parts.name: nine cell-kind modules
parts.essence: packages/core/src/cells/ holds exactly nine modules — value, sensor, formula, listener, api, program, router, io, ai — the TypeScript core's type taxonomy of what a cell can be; the same nine appear as the cell kinds in the fleet's decomposition sheets.
parts.failure_mode: ad-hoc cell kinds outside the nine breaking portability
parts.evidence: packages/core/src/cells/ directory listing (value.ts, sensor.ts, formula.ts, listener.ts, api.ts, program.ts, router.ts, io.ts, ai.ts)

cells.expr: Z_in, Z_out, JEPA, DoubleEntry, Vibe, GC, Murmur, Graph
watch proposes, Lucineer routes, Captain coordinates

layer_logic.0: substrate = the cell graph (any node function, nine kinds) with a conservation law (gamma + eta = budget) as its constitution
layer_logic.1: mechanism = 8 per-cell CNS primitives over discrete signals + Fascia gradients between cells; Hodge decomposition reads what changed; the API iterator grows agents; federation primitives link instances
layer_logic.2: policy = watching is participation (Fifth Impossibility), laws must survive reimplementation, no unified system gets precision+scale+adaptability, lanes are not to be crossed with code
layer_logic.3: interface = .qzt vessels, quilt:// URIs, the notebook-isomorphism, and a coordination protocol addressed to the other fleet
layer_logic.4: evidence = release receipts (15/61/79 tests), a ten-row architecture mapping, eight unposted SYNERGY stubs receipted honestly, and a filename/content drift hazard in the essay corpus
